posts.text: Vance, in Break With Trump, Blames Iran War for Republicans’ 2026 Midterm Losses — In a social media post, the vice president offered a critique of the administration’s agenda and messaging in what appeared to be an effort to distance himself from the president.

How Trump’s Energy Policies Helped Trigger Midterm Rout — The war in Iran, efforts to promote fossil fuels and attacks on renewable energy contributed to higher prices for gas and electricity that drove voter discontent.

Trump reacts to MASSIVE midterm LOSS at the WH ballroom construction site — While gaggling with reporters at the White House ballroom construction site, President Trump continued to defend the U.S. war with Iran while acknowledging it likely contributed to the major election losses suffered by Republicans.

What Trump’s Midterm Defeat Means for Iran and Oil Prices — Commentators abroad wondered what President Trump’s electoral losses might mean for oil prices, the war on Iran and the future of American politics.
Presidential hopeful Vance appears to question Iran war after polls debacle — Vance cited trusted pollster saying Iran war, Israel ties were top of mind for Trump voters swinging to Democrats.

Trump Lost Because He Betrayed America First — The Iran war was the biggest factor in this election. The president started the fight, made himself solely responsible for it, and guaranteed that his party would pay the cost for whatever happened, writes Michael Brendan Dougherty.
Photos: Iran marks US embassy takeover with rallies against US, Israel — Tehran rallies see slogans, flag burnings and claims of US-Israeli defeats amid historic embassy takeover anniversary.

More Iranians Call for Nuclear Weapons After War With U.S. — Some Iranian clerics and officials argue the country must rebuild deterrence by dropping its longstanding pledge not to build a nuclear bomb.
Trump says Iran war justified despite polls drubbing — Trump acknowledges Iran war played role in defeats but says he would launch it again.
Iranian leaders welcome US midterm results, but Trump may still attack — Tehran views midterm results as a rejection of Trump's 'war on Iran', signalling US frustration with foreign policy.

Trump-backed redistricting sought a midterm edge for Republicans. It didn't work — Republicans lost most of the Democratic-held seats they had targeted to flip, lost others they had banked on retaining and got swept out of power by a Democratic surge fueled by voter dissatisfaction with Trump, the economy and the war with Iran.

Trump 'couldn't transfer the love' of his supporters to other Republicans amid historic midterm loss — Donald Trump said he "couldn't transfer the love" from his rally supporters to Republican candidates after Democrats swept the midterm elections.

GOP's midterm defeat sparks bold claims from foreign leaders who've clashed with Trump — Pedro Sánchez says Americans voted against hate and climate denial as European leaders react to the Democratic Party's 2026 midterm victories.

World leaders who sparred with Trump express mix of relief, caution at GOP election rout — British Prime Minister Andy Burnham expressed hope the election results would focus minds in Washington and other capitals on ending the Iran war, which has sent fuel prices soaring — a major source of frustration for voters.

Iran takes a victory lap over stunning US election results, claims 'collapse has accelerated' — Iranian leaders claimed vindication after Democrats seized Congress, with JD Vance bluntly stating the war caused Republican midterm losses.

Back in the majority, Democrats have plans for a long list of Trump investigations — Democrats will have the ability to subpoena records and compel individuals to testify. The Epstein files, Elon Musk, the Iran war and Trump's business interests may all come under the microscope.

Iranian leaders say midterm results show U.S. voters have rejected Trump's war — Concerns about the war, particularly frustration over rising prices for fuel and other goods in the U.S., helped Democrats win control of both chambers of Congress in Tuesday's vote, a sharp setback for President Donald Trump and his Republican Party.

Fox News Voter Poll: 2026 midterm elections usher in a blue wave as Democrats win control of Congress — President Donald hTrump's job approval sank to 38% as inflation, tariffs and the Iran war drove a historic Democratic sweep of the House and the Senate.

Vance blames Iran war for GOP midterm losses — Vice President JD Vance seemingly sought to distance himself from election results seen as a referendum on President Donald Trump that featured big Republican losses across the country.

Vance's scathing Iran war postmortem puts potential 2028 GOP showdown in focus: 'Everyone knows why' — JD Vance blamed the war for Republicans' sweeping midterm elections losses, saying voters who backed Trump in 2024 turned against the party in 2026.
Victor Davis Hanson: Five Lessons from Trump’s Midterm Wipeout — The biggest takeaway from Tuesday’s results is how much we still don’t know, writes Victor Davis Hanson.
Republicans Got Crushed in the Midterms. Here’s What We Learned. — Niall Ferguson, Caitlin Flanagan, Mene Ukueberuwa, and more on last night’s political earthquake, and what it means for the country.

The world is reacting to the Democrats' sweeping midterm elections victory — From Kyiv to Moscow, and Tehran to Tel Aviv, all eyes were on the Democrats big win as foreign powers weigh how a flipped Congress will affect international relations.

Bohannan Unseats Miller-Meeks in Iowa, Flipping Key House Seat — Discontent about the war with Iran and tariffs helped create a tough environment for Representative Mariannette Miller-Meeks, the defeated Republican.

As Trump’s Midterm Deadline Looms, Gulf Countries Brace for Possible Renewal of Iran War — The energy-rich Gulf Arab countries are engaged in a flurry of mediation efforts to avert war between the U.S. and Iran, as many fear that the fighting will be worse this time around.
Why Trump Often Mentioned Iran in the Midterm Campaign — President Trump has repeatedly reminded Americans of a losing campaign issue just as voters head to the polls. Why?

Israeli Claims of Iranian Chemical Weapons Divide U.S. Officials — Some administration officials suggested Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is trying to draw President Trump back into military action.

Iran Says It Would Reopen Strait of Hormuz in 2 Days as Part of U.S. Deal — Iranian officials spoke of some progress in negotiating to reopen the strait even as they prepared for all-out war. A Qatari delegation arrived in Tehran on Monday to meet with the foreign minister to continue talks.

What the midterm elections could mean for markets, debt — Democrats winning Congress could mean tougher AI oversight and market volatility, while a Republican sweep may ease concerns over tech investigations.
